labels: the first frame of this shot: a macro view of a maple seedling growing from a winged samara on dark soil, golden backlight (same print style, same light, same palette).
how the film draws maple leaves and hanging samaras.
style anchor: the film's lawn, trunks and golden side-backlight.
prompt: Make one image, a refined full-colour Jiangnan water-print woodblock print in exactly the style of Image 1: decades later, at the same spot, the seedling has become ONE great old maple tree standing alone in the middle of a gentle lawn, seen from a low camera a little way off so the whole tree fits: a broad trunk with flared roots gripping the ground at the exact place where the seedling stood, a wide dome of five-lobed maple leaves in gold, ochre and a few red, and the outer branches heavy with hanging clusters of paired winged samaras glowing against the light. Low golden evening sun behind the tree at the upper left, rim light around the crown, long soft shadow toward the camera, the same soft dark-green bokeh-like woodland behind and a strip of warm paper sky. No buildings, no people, no text, no seals, no signatures.
